GAME CHANGER – The NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti GPU is beyond fast for gamers and creators. Experience lifelike virtual worlds, ultra-high FPS gaming, revolutionary new ways to create, and unprecedented workflow accelerati

BOLD DESIGN AND EFFORTLESS UPGRADE – The Legion Tower 5i’s transparent, tool-less side panel lets you easily upgrade and showcase your rig, while the customizable RGB lighting adds a personal touch to every session.
FUTURE-PROOF YOUR PASSIONS – The Legion Tower 5i delivers stutter-free gameplay, fast loading times, and seamless multitasking. It’s equipped with 32GB and expandable to 128GB of 5600MHz DDR5 memory.

ULTRA-FAST CONNECTIVITY – Stay connected and in control with 2.5G Ethernet, WiFi 6E, and versatile I/O ports. The Legion Tower 5i provides the speed and flexibility gamers and streamers need for uninterrupted sessions.

3 MONTHS XBOX GAME PASS – Enjoy day one blockbusters like Halo Infinite and Overwatch 2 with 3 months of included PC Game Pass and EA Play. With new games added all the time, there’s always something new to play.
EXCEPTIONAL PERFORMANCE – Game with up to 180W optimized air-cooling solutions to maintain peak performance while keeping your system cool and whisper-quiet.
